source_caption:
📺 2 Broke Girls (2011–2017)

2 Broke Girls follows Max Black, a sarcastic and street-smart waitress, and Caroline Channing, a formerly wealthy young woman who loses everything after her father’s financial scandal. Despite coming from completely different backgrounds, the two become unlikely best friends while working at a small diner in Brooklyn, New York. Determined to escape their financial struggles, Max and Caroline dream of opening their own cupcake business, saving every dollar they can while dealing with demanding customers, outrageous coworkers, complicated relationships, and hilarious everyday disasters. As their friendship grows, they discover that building a successful business takes determination, creativity, and plenty of patience. Combining sharp humor, unforgettable characters, and entertaining workplace situations, the series explores friendship, ambition, financial struggles, and chasing the American dream.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Sitcom • Workplace Comedy

⭐ IMDb: 6.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: ~22 minutes per episode • 6 seasons • 138 episodes

🎥 Creators: Michael Patrick King and Whitney Cummings

🏆 Recognition: Starring Kat Dennings and Beth Behrs, the series became a popular CBS comedy and won a Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Art Direction for a Multi-Camera Series.

source_details.synopsis: 2 Broke Girls (stylized as 2 BROKE GIRL$) is an American television sitcom that aired on CBS from September 19, 2011, to April 17, 2017. The series was produced for Warner Bros. Television and created by Michael Patrick King and Whitney Cummings. Set in the Williamsburg neighborhood of Brooklyn in New York City, the show's plot follows the lives of best friends Max Black (Kat Dennings) and Caroline Channing (Beth Behrs).
